Header Test Book

This book is printed with the browser's own header and footer, so every page has the date, the title and a page number in its margins. They are not part of the book and must be left out.

Chapter 1 Counting Up

A computer counts very quickly. The first sample shows a loop that counts for you and prints each number as it goes along.

#include <stdio.h>

int main(void) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        printf("%d\n", i);
    }
    return 0;
}

That is all there is to a counting loop. Change the numbers and it counts something else.

Chapter 2 Doubling

Doubling a number means multiplying it by two. The second sample does that with one box and prints the answer.

#include <stdio.h>

int main(void) {
    int n = 21;
    printf("%d\n", n * 2);
    return 0;
}

Every page of this book has the same header and footer, and the chapter names must stay.

Chapter 3 Greeting

The last sample says hello in a friendly way, using printf and a short sentence between the quotes.

#include <stdio.h>

int main(void) {
    printf("Hello there\n");
    return 0;
}
